messages.subject: Re: dblclick seems unresponsive
parts:
Hi Andrew, could you supply a reproducible example? Also, if you could include the output of sessionInfo(), that would be helpful.

On Sat, Oct 24, 2015 at 4:04 PM, Andrew Reynolds <andrewsco...@gmail.com> wrote:
I've made a shiny app which draws a choropleth map using ggplot2. I'm trying to add a zoom feature by using brush and dblclick to reset the xlim and ylim parameters. When I runApp() everything goes smoothly except for the dblclick part. I'm able to brush a rectangular box, but double clicking does nothing. I observe on http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/plot-interaction-zoom.html that the mouse cursor changes to a hand when hovering over the brushed box, but when I run my app, the cursor is a standard arrow-pointer. Any idea what the problem is? I should probably mention that it takes a few seconds for my map to get drawn initially. But when I double click, it doesn't get redrawn even after a long time (and it doesn't grey out like it's trying to redraw). Thanks.

--
